title: Annual Principal Labour Force Statistics by District
description: Annual principal labour force statistics at district level, including unemployment and participation rates.

fields.name: district
fields.title: Administrative District
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 160 administrative districts; however, it should be noted that only 140 administrative districts are represented in this dataset due to constraints on data availability at district level for more remote areas.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 since the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: lf
fields.title: Labour Force Size
fields.description: [Float, '000] The number (in thousands) of employed and unemployed individuals. This figure also represents the number of people participating in the labour force.

fields.name: lf_employed
fields.title: Employed Persons
fields.description: [Float, '000] The number (in thousands) of people who worked at least one hour for pay, profit or family gain, in thousands of people

fields.name: lf_unemployed
fields.title: Unemployed Persons
fields.description: [Float, '000] The number (in thousands) of people who did not work but were looking for work or available to work

fields.name: lf_outside
fields.title: Persons outside Labour Force
fields.description: [Float, '000] The number (in thousands) of people not classified as employed or unemployed, including housewives, students, early retired, disabled persons and those not interested in looking for a job

fields.name: u_rate
fields.title: Unemployment Rate
fields.description: [Float] Ratio of unemployed to labour force size

fields.name: p_rate
fields.title: Participation Rate
fields.description: [Float] Ratio of the labour force size to the working-age (15-64) population

fields.name: ep_ratio
fields.title: Employment-Population Ratio
fields.description: [Float] Ratio of the number of employed people to the working-age (15-64) population

methodology: This data is produced based on the Labour Force Survey (LFS), which is designed to collect representative data on the labour force at national and state level. Consistency in methodology has been maintained to ensure that the data is comparable over time. Survey findings are a monthly, quarterly and annual basis. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/lfs-technotes).
caveat: Data for 1991 and 1994 are not available at all due to limitations in the sample data from those years; data for W.P. Labuan and W.P. Putrajaya begin in 1992 and 2011 respectively. Furthermore, the sum of each category may not always equal to the totals shown in related tables because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
publication: The [Labour Force Report, 2023](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/labour_annual_2023), the latest edition of the annual labour force statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on the labour force](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/labour-market).
